children: Caleres reported second quarter 2026 net sales of $695.5 million, a 5.6% increase versus the prior year, and GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.71 (adjusted diluted EPS $0.47). GAAP gross margin expanded to 54.8% driven by Brand Portfolio performance and $55.6 million in tariff refunds; adjusted gross margin excluding tariff refunds was 46.8%. The company raised its full-year adjusted EPS outlook to $1.50–$1.65 and expects full-year net sales growth in the low-to-mid-single digits.
Revenue: Reported second quarter net sales of $695.5 million (13 weeks ended August 1, 2026), up 5.6% year-over-year.
Gross profit and margin: GAAP gross profit of $381.0 million with GAAP gross margin of 54.8%; adjusted gross profit excluding tariff refunds of $325.4 million and adjusted gross margin of 46.8%.
Operating income: GAAP operating earnings of $77.6 million for the quarter.

Net income and EPS: GAAP net earnings attributable to Caleres of $58.6 million, or $1.71 per diluted share; adjusted net earnings (excluding tariff refunds) of $16.1 million, or adjusted diluted EPS of $0.47.
Balance sheet / liquidity: Inventory at quarter-end $754.2 million; borrowings under revolver $288.0 million with $357.3 million available under the facility.

Brand Portfolio momentum: Brand Portfolio net sales increased 23.6% versus prior year and 8.2% organically excluding Stuart Weitzman; Brand Portfolio adjusted gross margin expanded materially to 49.1%.
International and Stuart Weitzman: International sales grew 57.0% (18.2% organically); Stuart Weitzman tracking in line with expectations, contributing $42.5 million in quarterly sales.
Famous Footwear performance: Famous Footwear net sales declined 6.3% with comparable sales down 5.9%; quarter-to-date through Labor Day, Famous comparable store sales were reported flat.
Channel mix: Direct-to-consumer represented ~71% of total net sales, and the company reported market share gains in Total Footwear and Women’s Fashion Footwear (per Circana).

Operational actions: Management indicated assortment realignment at Famous Footwear toward fashion (away from lifestyle athletic) and ongoing expense and tariff mitigation efforts expected to lift margins in upcoming quarters.
